title: gaura neomexicana var. coloradensis
intro: Gaura neomexicana var. coloradensis, commonly known as New Mexico bee blossom, is a perennial plant native to the southwestern United States. It is a flowering plant known for its delicate white, pink, or purple flowers and is often used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Gaura neomexicana var. coloradensis include its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation, while its therapeutic actions include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
